title: CueWIN: code and data for "Which Cue Wins? Causal Evidence on Gender Agreement in Arabic BERT Encoders"
description: Code, lexicon, per-item results and reproduction scripts for the paper "Which Cue Wins? Causal Evidence on Gender Agreement in Arabic BERT Encoders" (submitted to IEEE Access). Value, hidden-state and head-level patching, value zeroing, causal repair, cumulative-window and held-out cue-set analyses for AraBERTv02, CAMeLBERT-MSA, ARBERT and MARBERT, with a treebank (UD Arabic-PADT) check.
